# Source and rights

These four PNGs are static first-frame conversions of the `Dyson.gif`, `Frontier.gif`, `Puncture.gif`, and `SlowEnd.gif` artworks bundled in the supplied KyleOS project. Original artwork: **PrisonerCoin**. KyleOS project: **Rosenkranz/Person-008**.

**CC BY-NC-SA 3.0** applies to these images; they are NOT covered by the project's MIT code license. Attribution, artwork/source URLs, modification notes and licensing conditions are maintained in [`docs/CREDITS.md`](../../../docs/CREDITS.md). Do not relicense them as MIT. `Survey` was deliberately excluded due to unclear artwork rights.
